scenarios.title: SQL injection
scenarios.what: Union, boolean and time-based payloads against the product search and login.

scenarios.title: Cross-site scripting
scenarios.what: Reflected script, event-handler and tag payloads in the search and feedback fields.

scenarios.title: Path traversal & file inclusion
scenarios.what: Climb out of the web root and pull sensitive files.

scenarios.title: Command injection
scenarios.what: Chain OS commands onto a parameter the app passes to a shell.

scenarios.title: Template, SSRF & Log4Shell
scenarios.what: Server-side template evaluation, metadata SSRF and a JNDI lookup.

scenarios.title: Scanner sweep & secret probing
scenarios.what: An automated tool fingerprint plus a burst of probes for admin panels and secret files.

scenarios.title: Credential brute force
scenarios.what: Rapid-fire login attempts from one source, the behavioural detector's trigger.
